name: Cadmium arsenide

driven_states.emergent_property: Transient anomalous Hall conductivity under circularly polarized driving. Sign and spectrum allow the contributions to be assigned: direct photocurrent generation dominates, and the Floquet-Weyl contribution is demonstrably small.
driven_states.source: Murotani et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 131, 096901 (2023), doi:10.1103/PhysRevLett.131.096901
driven_states.caveat: Here the topological interpretation is precisely NOT supported but qualified - that is the value of this entry. Under resonant driving the Floquet-Weyl share is a minority contribution. The paper provides a general classification of the mechanisms (photocurrent, inverse Faraday effect, Floquet-Berry) that transfers directly to the graphene case. Sign analyzis is the decisive tool; pure amplitude measurements cannot separate the mechanisms.

threshold.quantity: linearity in fluence up to 20 microjoule per cm^2, flattening above

driven_states.measured_quantity: complex THz Faraday rotation, from which the Hall conductivity is obtained; sign as discriminator

sources: Murotani et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 131, 096901 (2023), doi:10.1103/PhysRevLett.131.096901
